purpose: Teach: カーソル/落合/錬金術/色気/ポルシェ/初恋/川柳/バッシング

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマウスのカーソルの動かし方教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going to show you how to move the mouse cursor.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. Gentle opening. Slight lift at the end—a small gift being offered. Conversational pace, no pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと落合監督の本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read that book about Manager Ochiai with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to report. Quick delivery. Open, genuinely pleased—the tone of a child who wants you to know something he learned. No artifice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが錬金術のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father watched a documentary about alchemy.
lines.style: Calm relay of information. Soft, observant tone. Slight pause—she's noting something about the choice of subject. Not questioning, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、色気って言葉、ぼく、よくわからないよ
lines.en: Mom, I don't really understand what 'allure' means.
lines.style: Genuine, uncertain. Small voice. The question of a child thinking out loud, trusting she'll help. Hesitant on the word itself—testing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがポルシェの雑誌をお見せ下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed you a Porsche magazine.
lines.style: Same calm relay. Pattern-matching in her voice—three of these now. Gentle amusement underneath. Still warm, but there's a faint smile in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと初恋の絵本読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a picture book about first love with Dad.
lines.style: Same eager brightness as before. Innocent, unguarded. Reporting something sweet he did together. No self-consciousness—just happiness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが川柳をお作りになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father wrote a senryu poem.
lines.style: Quieter now. The pattern is clear to her. Gentler voice—almost to herself. She's beginning to understand what he's doing. Warm but with a note of tender recognition.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ニュースで芸能人のバッシング聞いて悲しかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I heard people on the news being really mean to a celebrity and it made me sad.
lines.style: Subdued, thoughtful. Slower pace. The brightness is gone—he's genuinely troubled. Soft trailing-off. A child processing something that doesn't make sense to him. Reaching for understanding.
